note: Stage-3 seeds: short hand-written descriptions of property disputes (positive) and of look-alike matters that are not (negative). Judgments are compared with these by embedding similarity. Replace or extend with real judgment openings once a labelled sample exists (ingest_plan.md §10).

positive.text: Suit for specific performance of an agreement to sell immovable property; the purchaser paid earnest money and was ready and willing to pay the balance sale consideration, but the vendor refused to execute the sale deed.
The buyer seeks refund of the advance paid under an agreement for sale of a plot after the seller sold the same land to a third party.
Suit for declaration of title over the suit property and cancellation of a registered sale deed alleged to be void.
Dispute over ownership of agricultural land based on a gift deed and a subsequent sale deed executed by the original owner.
Suit for recovery of possession of the suit premises and permanent injunction restraining the defendants from encroaching upon the land.
Partition suit among coparceners claiming shares in ancestral joint family property under the Hindu Succession Act.
Challenge to a mutation entry in the revenue records and the record of rights for a survey number, ordered by the Tehsildar.
Land owners seek enhancement of compensation for land acquired by the State under the Land Acquisition Act for a public purpose.
Landlord's petition for eviction of the tenant from the rented premises for bona fide personal need and arrears of rent under the Rent Control Act.
Flat buyers complain against the builder for delay in handing over possession of apartments and seek refund with interest under RERA.
Dispute about an easementary right of way across the neighbour's land to reach the plaintiff's house.
The plaintiff claims title to the land by adverse possession, having been in open and continuous possession for more than twelve years.
The accused forged a sale deed and impersonated the owner to sell land belonging to the complainant; cheating and forgery in a property transaction.
Suit for redemption of a mortgage over a house property and a dispute whether the property was held benami.
Appeal against a decree granting a temporary injunction restraining alienation of the suit schedule property pending the suit.
Dispute over khasra and khatauni entries for agricultural land and the names recorded in the jamabandi.

negative.text: Appeal against conviction for possession of ganja and heroin under the NDPS Act; recovery of contraband from the accused.
The accused was found in possession of an unlicensed firearm and cartridges and was convicted under the Arms Act.
Application for regular bail by an accused in custody for offences of murder and criminal conspiracy.
Income tax appeal on assessment of rental income from house property and disallowance of deductions.
Writ petition by a government employee challenging denial of promotion, seniority and pension benefits.
Petition for divorce on grounds of cruelty and claim for maintenance by the wife under Section 125.
Claim for compensation by the family of a victim who died in a motor vehicle accident before the tribunal.
Petition under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act to appoint an arbitrator in a commercial supply contract dispute.
Criminal appeal against conviction for murder based on circumstantial evidence and the testimony of eyewitnesses.
Company petition alleging oppression and mismanagement by directors and shareholders of a private company.
Election petition challenging the result of a municipal election on grounds of corrupt practices.
Complaint for dishonour of a cheque issued towards repayment of a hand loan under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act.
